quarterly_data.signal: Unisys (10-K): 2025 revenue was $1,950.1 million (2024: $2,008.4 million), with License & Support revenue of $428.1 million at a 68.7% gross margin and Ex-L&S revenue of $1,522.0 million; segment revenue was Digital Workplace Solutions $508.4 million, Cloud, Applications & Infrastructure Solutions $732.8 million and Enterprise Computing Solutions $628.9 million. Backlog was $3.16 billion at December 31, 2025 (2024: $2.84 billion), mainly on Ex-L&S renewal signings, with approximately $1.11 billion (35%) expected to convert to revenue in 2026; remaining performance obligations were approximately $0.9 billion. No single customer accounts for more than 10% of revenue, and Unisys relies on a single or limited number of suppliers for certain technology products.
